lokele: Imi Paulo Botomomu, inga wa bato, la inga ko l’eoka ya bato, kangä ko la Yesu Masiya la Mungu Sango oyatɛmoloko Inde nda liwa,
english: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, 1:1 and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

lokele: iso la bitungani bitotina ebile amamwito lami, tosotoma lokasa-lo ende eba bitanda nda Galatia.
english: and all the brothers 1:2 who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

lokele: Bootaota la lilatemi lia Mungu Sango la elia Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya biyaleke lanu;
english: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

lokele: Masiya nd’afaka liwawi liande angɛnɛ eoka ya batwanelo basu mbo auwesek’iso nda mbile-ye ya obe, ko la lisangi lia Mungu Sango wasu;
english: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

lokele: Indeataliomoko tala layalaya, ongoma! Mboli Ilaa yafomoko ko la Yesu Masiya
english: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

lokele: Isoomwala mbo osoumama ndosɛnyana la Inde oyasot’ino lioi ko la booto wa Masiya okawatema la mboli ilau ya bɔfɔnɔ wasi,
english: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

lokele: ebiti Mboli Ilau yasi, kongo ko bato basi batoeyaeyes’ino la basolɛmbe ndofenyaka Mboli Ilau ya Masiya.
english: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

lokele: Kongo ko ango iso, ango bokitomo wa Use, ekambes’ino mboli ilau ebisotwana la yao ebisokambesa’mi okambes’ino, ambo inde asendomoko bieo!
english: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

lokele: Kwa aongiki’mi oso, kwa akoonga’mi liasi imɔ, mbo ango boto atokambes’ino mboli ilau ebisotwana la yao ebisɔɔl’ino oso, inde asendomoko bieo!
english: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

lokele: ¿Mbo isɔɔngɔlɔ to bato kwani, kwa mbo Mungu angɛnɛ? ¿Mbo isokota ndoomalesa bato? Ango yeomalesa bato kwani, ambo iti bɔkɔwa wa Masiya.
english: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

lokele: Iluwesek’ino, bitungani yami, mbo Mboli Ilau ebisonangolomo lami biti ya bato,
english: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

lokele: eoka itiɔlɛkɛ yao ende bato, itiekesomo la bato, kongo ko biafomoko ende’mi ko la lɔɛnɛsɔmu loa Yesu Masiya.
english: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

lokele: Osooka to boyaeli wami wa oso nda loasɔ loa lisemoli lia Mungu elitosemokola BaYuda, la mbo yakongolaka Etanda ya Mungu la bowau finɛ, yabebekesaka yao la efango finɛ.
english: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

lokele: La yalongaka bato wike ba fɛtɔ yami nda loasɔ loa lisemoli lia Mungu la yafumbaka finɛ ndokɔcha ebisoimelomo la basango bami.
english: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

lokele: Kongo ko asangaka Mungu oyüchaka’mi ko nda sɔlɔ ya nyango wami, la oyataka’mi lioi ko la booto wande,
english: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,

lokele: mbo ɛnɛsɛkɛ Wana wande ende’mi, litina mbo inangoleke Mboli Ilau yande ende bato ba wenda; lisasaya ititwane kuko la bolomboki,
english: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

lokele: itiɛkɛ nda Yelusaleme end’ebayalaka Batomomu oso wami, kongo ko imi lɔkɛ nda yese ya Alaba, limɔ mbisa imi loinwa nda bokenge wa Damaseke.
english: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

lokele: Mbisa ya miaka isatɔ imi lɔkɛ nda Yelusaleme fɛtɛti okaluwana la Kefa, ako Petelo, la imi loyalaka lande becho liu la bɔɔmwi.
english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

lokele: Nde itiɛnɛkɛ Botomomu wasi sakolo ngo ko Yakobo etungani ya Ngɛnɛ wasu.
english: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.

lokele: Nda njasɔ-bi ebisɔni’mi end’ino, tɛnɛ ngo, oso wa Mungu, itite lolanga.
english: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, 1:20 before God, I’m not lying.

lokele: Limɔ mbisa, imi lɔkɛ nda yese ya Sulia la Kilikia;
english: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

lokele: nde ititaluwomoko bɔmbɔ ende eba bitanda ba Masiya nda Yudea,
english: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

lokele: bokakä kongo mbo— Inde oyakongolaka iso asonangola loasɔ loa liimeli eloabebesak’inde oso.
english: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

lokele: Iyo loinela imɔ Mungu eoka yami.
english: So they glorified God in me.

lokele: Limɔ mbisa ya miaka liu la inɛi imi lɔkɛ liasi nda Yelusaleme, amamwito la Balanaba, la iso lɔkɛsɛnɛ la Tito imɔ.
english: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

lokele: Nde imi lɔkɛ ko l’eoka ya liɛnɛsu eliɛnɛkɛ’mi la imi losanoel’iyo Mboli Ilau ebisonangola’mi end’eba wenda; nde imi losanola ende ebale bolitesomo, ko wisakumbo, mbo itatimbaka la likuwa ko wawa kongo.
english: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

lokele: Ango Tito oyaaka lami, kwa ayali inde boto wa BaHela, atiatinjomoko ndotena itombe;
english: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

lokele: loaka nde loasɔ loa balimbakeli bamɔi ebaowaowaka nda ikumbɛ wisakumbo mbo baläeke esaela eyele lasu eba Yesu Masiya mbo bakandakek’iso liasi nda bekili ya oso.
english: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,

lokele: Nde totikulye ndolites’iyo ango saa ango ɛmɔi, mbo wewe wa Mboli Ilau botikaleke lanu la wɛlï.
english: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

lokele: Kongo ko betoli oso ina—loti to loasɔ ende’mi kwa ayalak’iyo oso, Mungu aitoluwa bɔmbɔ wa boto—betoli oso ina batiteleke’mi litï liyai.
english: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

lokele: Kongo ko ɛnɛk’iyo mbo Mboli Ilau bisofomo’mi mbo ikɛkɛ okanangola ende eba sunga, kwa asotomo Petelo ende ebasotena totombe,
english: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—

lokele: (eoka Inde oyafaka Petelo isosha sha likuwa ende eba totombe, afak’imɔ ko’mi isosha sha likuwa ende eba wenda)
english: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—

lokele: la aluwaka iyo booto ewafomoko’mi, limɔ Yakobo la Kefa la Yoane, ebatangomu Bakole ba Etanda, iyo lofaef’iso la Balanaba bosamba wa olome wonyangel’iso l’isosha shɔkɛ ndokanangola ende eba wenda, ani iyo angɛnɛ kɔkɛ ende ebasotena totombe;
english: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

lokele: kongo ko iyo lɔlɛmbɛ mbo toenyeleke bato eba touwe, la imi lofumbaka finɛ ndokela ngo ko ongoma.
english: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

lokele: Nde ayaka Kefa nda bokenge wa Antiokia imi lof’inde liɛngɔ ko oso wa bɔmbɔ wande eoka ayalaka ko se nda loasɔ-lo.
english: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

lokele: Eoka oso wa loyo loa bato bamɔi ebatomomoko la Yakobo, Kefa lolaka bieka amamwito l’ebati BaYuda; kongo ko ayaka bato ana ba Yakobo, limɔ inde loakola ndosɛnyana lau sumbu eoka inde lowanga ebateni totombe.
english: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

lokele: Limɔ BaYuda ebamɔi lowatema lande nda bokwelakwela eboti la momongo, ongoma ko Balanaba imɔ lokuliana lau nda bokwelakwela-bo.
english: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛkɛ’mi mbo batikɛndɛ fii nda mboka ya wewe wa Mboli Ilau, imi loonga la Kefa oso wau batotina, imi mbo— ¿Eya mbo aɛ, oyale waYuda osolitesa boyaeli w’ebati BaYuda, inga to imɔ kwa wao wa BaYuda, monito ototinjäka ebati BaYuda ndolitesa boyaeli wa BaYuda?
english: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

lokele: Iso twende balomboki ba BaYuda, toti to bato ba batwanelo ba wenda-bo,
english: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,

lokele: nde tosoluwa mbo boto aitofomo likolo ko l’eoka yolitesa Bikela, sakolo ngo ko la lilendelu liolendelo Masiya Yesu; la iso nd’asolendelo Masiya Yesu, mbo tofomoko likolo ko la lilendelu nda lina lia Masiya, inga ko l’eoka yolitesa Bikela, litina mbo bolomboki ango ɔmɔi angofomo likolo ko l’eoka yolitesa Bikela.
english: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

lokele: Nde ango iso tokotaka ndofomo likolo ko ende Masiya, tooshomoko imɔ ko la batwanelo, mbo Masiya atotangomo mbo bofaekefi wa batwanelo? Mbayo, ango sinyo!
english: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!

lokele: Nde ango yeswaka liasi ndakɔ eyesotawɛlɛkɛ’mi se, ambo isoɛnɛsɛ bato mbo imi angɛnɛ yende ngɛnɛ wa litwanelo.
english: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.

lokele: Eoka imi nd’asowela Bikela ko l’eoka ya Bikela, mbo iyaleke la loiko ko la Mungu.
english: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.

lokele: Isowa to la liwa eliawaka Yesu nda lieka, nde ati to’mi oyale la liwawi, Masiya nd’ayali too ende’mi; la liwawi elisoyala lami nda bindo kwani, lisowawa ko la lilendelu lia Wana wa Mungu oyasamaka’mi la oyafaka liwawi liande angɛnɛ ko l’eoka yami.
english: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.

lokele: Ititombole booto wa Mungu, eoka ango liengani lilendelo ko Bikela kongo, ani Masiya awaka ko liwela.
english: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”

lokele: He! Ino BaGalatia wende bibebe! ¿Ndai asosinj’ino, ani oso wa baiso banu Yesu Masiya ɛnɛlɛkɛ fololo nda liwa lia lieka?
english: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?

lokele: Ilɛmbi mbo omutoeleke’mi ko lofelo-lo mbo— ¿Waɔlɔkɔ nde Bolimo ko l’eoka yolitesa Bikela kwa l’eoka yolaila la lilendelu?
english: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

lokele: ¿Wende to bibebe ani? ¿Waakolaka l’eoka ya Bolimo, kwani ototungama nde loasɔ loa bindo?
english: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

lokele: ¿Wokakä nde tale wike ko liokela, ango liende ko liokela?
english: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

lokele: ¿Oyasofotes’ino la Bolimo la oyatokelaka bisisho sisi yanu, akeli nde ongoma ko l’eoka yolitesa Bikela kwa l’eoka yolaila Mboli yande la lilendelu?
english: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

lokele: Ko ongoma Abalayama alendeloko Mungu, la lilendelu liande liatangomokö end’inde mbo liengani.
english: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.” Genesis 15:6

lokele: Luwaka to mbo bato ebale la lilendelu, iyo ana bende bana ba Abalayama.
english: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.

lokele: Lokasa loa Mungu loatatondoloko mbo Mungu elaenganesaka bato ko la lilendelu, loafaka Abalayama mboli ilau biko mbo— Ko l’eoka yaɛ bato ba wenda bototina befotesomoko.
english: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.” Genesis 12:3

lokele: Eokao bato ba lilendelu basofotesomo amamwito la Abalayama oyaaka ewa lilendelu.
english: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

lokele: Eoka ebasolendelo lilitesi lia Bikela, basosendomo bieo; ani asosɔnɔmɔ nda Lokasa mbo— Batotina ebaitokokomo nda lilitesi lia bitotina eyasɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa loa Bikela batosendomo bieo ani batikeleke ongoma.
english: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.” Deuteronomy 27:26

lokele: Losoluwana to fololo mbo nda baiso ba Mungu angwɛnɛ boto woengana ko l’eoka ya Bikela; eoka mbo— Ewa liengani eikaka ko la lilendelu;
english: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.” Habakkuk 2:4

lokele: nde Bikela biti ko l’eoka ya lilendelu, kangä mbo— Oyatolitesa bikela eikaka ko l’eoka ya yao.
english: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.” Leviticus 18:5

lokele: Masiya aendolak’iso mbo totasendomo bieo ya Bikela, ani Inde angɛnɛ asendomoko bieo ko l’eoka yasu, eoka lososɔnɔmɔ nda Lokasa mbo— Batotina ebatokakema nda isandu basendomoko bieo!
english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,” Deuteronomy 21:23

lokele: Asendomoko bieo mbo, ko la Yesu Masiya lifoti lia Abalayama liyeke ende bato ba wenda la mbo tɔɔlɛkɛ Bolimo oyatikomoko lisakä ko la lilendelu.
english: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

lokele: Bitungani yami, isoluwes’ino litina ko la loasɔ loasu bato; boto angɛnɛ eta ngɛla, angwɛnɛ boto wasi koola yao, ango kokikola litina lia yao, ani ngɛla esokɔchɔmɔ.
english: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.

lokele: Basakä bamɔi batikelomoko to Abalayama la lioti liande; Lokasa angoonga mbo— Baoti baɛ wike, mba, kangä mbo— Lioti liaɛ, litina mbo oto ɔmwito ako Masiya.
english: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. 3:16 He doesn’t say, “To descendants 3:16 ”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, Genesis 12:7 which is Christ.

lokele: Litina elitoonga’mi lile mbo— Bikela ebisoya ko miaka mia inɛi la kama isatɔ mbisa ani Ngɛla yakɔchɔmɔkɔ la Mungu ko oso wa Bikela, la yao angoola Ngɛla la angotombola lisakä.
english: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

lokele: Nde ango botiko watikomoko ko l’eoka yolitesa Bikela, ambo botifomo ko la lisakä lia Mungu; kongo ko Mungu nd’afaefaka Abalayama botiko ko la lisakä.
english: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

lokele: ¿Bikela to bile la lini litina? Bikela yataliomoko nda lisakä eoka ya batwanelo ko nda akayeke lioti aliatikomoko lisakä; yao lotomo ko la bakitomo la besamba ya ikomya.
english: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

lokele: Nde ikomya atiyale ko boto ɔmwito kongo, kangä Mungu angɛnɛ ale Ɔmwito.
english: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

lokele: ¿Mbo Bikela bitokufesa basakä ba Mungu? Mba, ango sinyo! Eoka eya to mbo Bikela bekɔkɔlɔ ndofaefa bato loiko, ani liengani liafomoko end’ato ko l’eoka ya Bikela.
english: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

lokele: Kongo ko Lokasa loa Mungu losoluwesa mbo bitotina bisoliyakomo ko la Bobe, litina mbo lisakä eliatikomoko eoka ya lilendelu lia Yesu Masiya, lifomoko end’ebatolendelo Inde.
english: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

lokele: Oso ani lilendelu likafomu iso, twalambomoko la twakanjomoko ko la Bikela ko nd’akaɛnɛsɔmɔkɔ lilendelu angɛnɛ.
english: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

lokele: Ongoma Bikela bile kwa köse ya bainɛngɛ end’iso, ndokɛs’iso la bosamba ende Masiya mbo toenganesomoko ko la lilendelu.
english: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

lokele: Kongo ko kwani asoya lilendelu, ongoma to’imɔ nda bosamba wa köse.
english: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

lokele: Eoka ino yaatotina wende bana ba Mungu ko l’eoka ya lilendelu liolendelo Masiya Yesu.
english: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

lokele: Batotina banu ebasulufiomo to ende Masiya, osowataka boyaeli wa Masiya.
english: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

lokele: Ongoma angwɛn’imɔ WaYuda, kwa WaHela, angwɛn’imɔ bɔkɔwa kwa iote, angwɛn’imɔ otolome kwa otomali; eoka ino batotina fɛɛ wende ɔmwito ko ende Masiya Yesu;
english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

lokele: la eya mbo wende ba Masiya, ambo ino wend’imɔ ba lioti lia Abalayama la imɔ ebasosangola botiko wande ko l’eoka ya lisakä.
english: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.

lokele: Imi mbo— Ko la mbile eyekayaleke bosangoli ko wainɛngɛ ale ko bɔfɔnɔ wa bɔkɔwa, ani wewe ende ngɛnɛ wa yatotina,
english: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,

lokele: asosɛlɔmɔ ose ya isosha sha betingani la benyafala ko nda lisho elisotinyomo la sango.
english: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

lokele: Ende iso ko ongoma; ayalak’iso bainɛngɛ, twayalaka bɛkɔwa ya bolimo wa boyaläala wa wenda-bo.
english: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

lokele: Nde enganaka mbile chaa, Mungu lotoma Wana wande ndoyaotomo la botomali, ko nda yakakaelo ya Bikela,
english: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

lokele: mbo aendoleke ebayalaka nda isosha sha Bikela la mbo aɔlɛsɛk’iso ishosha shotangomo bana bande.
english: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.

lokele: Limɔ eoka mbo wende bana, Mungu asotomel’iso Bolimo wa Wana wande nda betema yasu, oyatoamama mbo— Abba, Sango wasu.
english: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, 4:6 Father!”

lokele: Ongoma to, oti’mɔ bɔkɔwa, kangä wana angɛnɛ; ango boyala wana, ambo wende imɔ bosangoli wa botiko ko l’eoka ya isosha sha Mungu.
english: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

lokele: Nde nda mbile ena ani atialuwak’ino Mungu, wasɛlɔmɔkɔ bɛkɔwa ya belimɔ ebiti la boyaeli wa mungu,
english: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

lokele: kongo ko kwani asoluw’ino Mungu, angoko ndoluwana la Mungu, monito osoinywa liasi nda belima ya boyalaäla la eya bɔlɛmbu la mbuwa ebisolɛmbɛ ino mbo boyalesomoko bɛkɔwa ko liasi?
english: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

lokele: Ino nd’atolitekesa baise la tengai la byaa la miaka.
english: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

lokele: Isowanga to loasɔ loanu kwa mbo isookel’ino bonui wa likuwa ko liokela.
english: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

lokele: Bitungani yami, isolɔmbɔkɔl’ino mbo okinjweke kwa ayali nde’mi, eoka imi nd’asokinjwa kwa ayali nde ino. Otiakeelaka’mi obe oso;
english: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

lokele: oluwi nde mbo ko l’eoka ya lokambo loa bindo yanangoelak’ino Mboli Ilau osooso,
english: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

lokele: la kwa ayalaka boyaeli wami la tale finɛ end’ino, otiaolyaka’mi la otiafekaka’mi, nde wanyangelaka’mi kwa mbo yaaka bokitomo wa Mungu, eingo kwa mbo Masiya Yesu angɛnɛ.
english: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

lokele: ¿Bootaota ona wanu bole to anima kwani? Isoaola la wɛlï mbo, yambo wakɔkɔlɔ, ani waɔmɔlɔ baiso banu mbo ofaefeke’mi bao!
english: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

lokele: ¿Mbo isokinjwa wiyani lanu ko l’eoka mbo isokambes’ino ko loasɔ elole wewe?
english: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

lokele: Bamɔi basofɔɔl’ino, inga la bolau, kangä eoka mbo basosanga ndosakoel’ino angɛnɛ mbo ino angɛnɛ ofɔɔlɛk’iyo.
english: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

lokele: Lole lolau ndolukomo la bofiili nda njasɔ bilau ko mbile bitotina, inga ko ani eyayaelaka’mi lanu kongo,
english: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

lokele: ino bana bami bakɛkɛ, isokel’ino ikɛnɛnɛ liasi kwa toelo angɛnɛ ko nda akaotelomoko ino Masiya.
english: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—

lokele: Ilɛmbi to finɛ ndoyala lanu kwanikwani, la ndoonga lanu la baölo ba bɔfɔnɔ wasi eoka isoka botema wale loasɔ loanu. Ikweelo sha loasɔ loa bana bambale ba Abalayama
english: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

lokele: Kambesaka’mi, ino ebalɛmbi ndokomyiomo la Bikela, ¿Mbo otioke to bakakanelo ba Bikela?
english: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

lokele: Loasɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa loa Bikela mbo Abalayama ayalaka la banatolome ambale, ɔmɔi wana wa bɔkɔwa otomali la ɔmɔi wana wa wali iote;
english: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.

lokele: kongo ko wana wa otomali ako bɔkɔwa lootomo ko l’eoka ya isosha sha bindo, nde wana wa wali iote lootomo ko l’eoka ya lisakä lia Mungu.
english: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

lokele: Loasɔ-lo lole bombila ebole la litina end’iso; Batomali-ba bende kwa Ngɛla imbale. Ngɛla ɛmɔi yaaka ya löngo loa Sinai eyengani la Agala ewa bɔkɔwa la bana ba ngɛla ena basootomo ko bɛkɔwa ya yao.
english: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

lokele: Löngo loa Sinai lole nda yese ya Alaba, la losokweelomo la Yelusaleme eyayali kwani eoka bo-kenge-bo la bana bande lisanga, bende bɛkɔwa.
english: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

lokele: Kongo ko Yelusaleme eyele nda Use ende la bɔfonɔ wa wali iote ako Sala la wao bole nyango wasu.
english: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

lokele: Loasɔnɔmɔkɔ mbo— Yaimwaka la limɛngɔ, otomali wa ekomba oyatiaotaka wana, Anjanjaka la amamaka la linɛngina aɛ oyatiaokaka toelo; Eoka loketi loa bana ba botomali wa booi, Losolonga eloa bana ba botomali oyale la bolome!
english: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.” Isaiah 54:1

lokele: Bitungani yami, tole to bana ba lisakä, kwa ayalaka Yisaka,
english: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

lokele: nde kwa inde oyaotomoko ko loasɔ loa bindo angɛnɛ akongolaka kwalakwala inde oyaotomoko ko loasɔ loa Bolimo, lole to ongoma nda mbile-ye.
english: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

lokele: Kongo ko, ¿Lokasa loa Mungu losoonga moni? Lokasa mbo— Sayaka bɔkɔwa la wanaotolome wande, eoka wana wa bɔkɔwa aitofomo likaɔ lia botiko amamwito l’ewa iote.
english: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.” Genesis 21:10

lokele: Eokao to, Bitungani yami, toti bana ba bɔkɔwa otomali, kangä bana ba iote sha wali.
english: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.

lokele: Emakalaka to sikɔkɔ kwa toote ani asofaikolomo iso ko la Masiya, la okandokomöko imɔ liasi ko la bɔnyɔlɔlɔ wa bɔkɔwa.
english: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

lokele: Tɛnɛ, imi Paulo nd’asoonga lanu mbo— Botinyomo itombe, ani Masiya angosung’ino nda loasɔ angolɔmɔi.
english: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

lokele: Eingo, isokambes’ino liasi la wɛlï mbo batotina ebasotinyomo itombe baondu nde ndolitesa Bikela bitotina.
english: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

lokele: Ino ebasotanga mbo wenganesomoko ko l’eoka yolitesa Bikela, ososɛnyana la Masiya; osoomelo booto.
english: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

lokele: Eoka iso nd’asoombakelaka iyɛli sha liengani ko la lilendelu.
english: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

lokele: Ende ebasowatema la Masiya Yesu, itombe sile wawa, la losunga lole imɔ ko wawa, kangä lilendelu litofumbaka ko l’eoka ya losamɔ.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

lokele: Wakɛndɛkɛ l’olau finɛ nda mboka, ¿ndai to asokufesel’ino ndotutaka wewe angɛnɛ?
english: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

lokele: Lifumbesi liokufes’ino litiye ko la Inde oyatak’ino lioi liotut’Inde.
english: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

lokele: Sinyo sha bänä ba lilaka sitokɔkɔlɔ ndokakesa lituma litotina elisobiomu la shao.
english: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

lokele: Isolendelo Ngɛnɛ wasu loasɔ loanu mbo ino angoenyela baenyeli basi la mbo boto ona oyasoeyaeyesa ino, kwa asisa kwa ndai, inde ona atokuchomo la bowau.
english: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

lokele: Kongo ko, Bitungani yami, eya to mbo imi nd’atonangoela bato mbo batenomoko itombe, ¿Monito isokongolomo imɔ ko kwani? Ani sɔni ya liwa lia lieka lisosilesomo.
english: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

lokele: Bolau mbo ebasolɛlɛs’ino batinyek’iyo angɛnɛ lokomba. Iote sitifomo isosha sholitesa yɛmɛ ya bindo
english: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

lokele: Bitungani yami, ino nd’atomu lioi mbo oyaleke toote, kongo ko iote sina sitayala fofe sholitesa yɛmɛ ya bindo, kangä mbo bokuwekelaneke kwa bɛkɔwa ko la losamɔ.
english: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

lokele: Eoka Bikela bitotina bisokɔchɔmɔ ko la liölo limwito, liko mbo— Samaka boyalani laɛ kwa ani otosama aɛ angɛnɛ.
english: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.” Leviticus 19:18

lokele: Nde ango boichakanaka la bolakanaka komba, tichaka la wɛlï mbo botasɛɛsɛlɛ fɛɛ!
english: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

lokele: Isoonga lanu mbo— Kɛndɛkɛndɛkɛ ko la wɛlï wa Bolimo, limɔ otiangɔɔlɔlɛsɛ yɛmɛ ibe ya bindo.
english: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

lokele: Eoka yɛmɛ ya bindo bitonanaka la Bolimo la lisangi lia Bolimo litonanaka la bindo. Yao imbale bisoiyelakana mbo otakela yao ebisosang’ino okela.
english: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

lokele: Eya mbo botutaka Bolimo, ani otikakalesomo ko la Bikela.
english: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

lokele: Bekeeli ebitofumbekesomo la bindo bisoluwana fololo, biko bolëfë bowɛwɛ, ifoifoi;
english: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

lokele: lisemoli lia bɛfɔnɔ ya mungu, basoo, liya, liwesani, lisiyela, bifango, shɛnɛsɛ, lisɛnyani;
english: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

lokele: toloi twa ebisoimelomo, luno, liwa lia bänä, bisha ya tosumbe la njasɔ yasi ya bɔfɔnɔ-bo. Isotaonga lanu kwa aimaka’mi oimak’ino ko oso, mbo ebatokela bɔfɔnɔ-bo wa njasɔ batiɔtɛkɛ nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu.
english: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

lokele: Nde tuma twa eula ya Bolimo twende losamɔ, limɛngɔ, lilatemi, limɛsɛkɛlɛni, booto, boyaeli bolau, liengani, botema wolendelomo,
english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, 5:22

lokele: botema sambo, botema wokakalesa yɛmɛ ya bindo. Njasɔ ya bɔfɔnɔ-bo bitikufesomo la bikela.
english: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

lokele: Ebasoomana la Masiya Yesu basoola ebisok’iso nda botema la yɛmɛ ya bindo lisanga ko ndoola yao nda lieka.
english: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

lokele: Toyala to la liwawi lia Bolimo, ambo tokɛndɛkɛ ko fii nda mboka ya Bolimo.
english: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

lokele: Toyalëke to la lomuli loa bɔmɛtɔ, la lɔfɔlɔ, toyalanëke la bokelë.
english: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

lokele: Kongo ko Bitungani yami, eya to mbo boto wa Etanda eoshomo nda litwanelo, ino ebafomu Bolimo Botanu kokomya boto-yo la botema sambo; la ino angɛnɛ tichaka la wɛlï mbo otakwa nda lisoshela.
english: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

lokele: Tolakanaka belito, ongoma otokɔcha ekela ya Masiya.
english: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

lokele: Boto nde koenyela mbo ende boto wolitesomo, ani wewe ati yeka, ongoma asolimba botema wande angɛnɛ.
english: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

lokele: Bolau ko mbo boto la boto akɔtɔlɛkɛ eliande likuwa, limɔ atoyala la litina lioomala eoka ya eliande likuwa, inga eoka ya elia boto wasi.
english: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

lokele: Boto la boto atotolaka bolito wa bokuku wande angɛnɛ.
english: For each man will bear his own burden.

lokele: Oyatoekesomoko lioi lia Mboli Ilau, afaefeke oyatoekes’inde likaɔ lia yeka yande bitotina.
english: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

lokele: Olimbomöko nda betema yanu; oitotelaka Mungu kungutu, eoka kwa bɔfɔnɔ wa koto ebitolɔɔkɔ boto, atotwaka ngo ko eula ya bɔfɔnɔ-ao.
english: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

lokele: Oyatolɔɔ elanga ya bindo yande angɛnɛ, etwaka ngo ko ebiyɔlu; nde oyatolɔɔ elanga ya Bolimo, etwaka ngo ko loiko loa layalaya.
english: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

lokele: Totatɛkwɛ̈kɛ okelaka bolau, eoka akayeke lisho lioengana, iso kotwa eula ani totitaweke likati.
english: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

lokele: Eokao akayalek’iso la fofe, tokeeleke bato batotina booto, nde simbi to end’iyo ebale bofindi wa ebasoimela. Baoi ba losilo loa lokasa eloasɔnɔkɔ Paulo angɛnɛ
english: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

lokele: Tɛnɛ ndembe bifi ebisɔnɛli’mi ino ko la bosamba wami angɛnɛ!
english: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

lokele: Bato ebalɛmbi ndɔɛnɛlɛ la olau loasɔ loa bindo, iyo ana basotinjak’ino mbo otinyomoko totombe, litina mbo iyo angɛnɛ batakongolomo loasɔ loa lieka lia Masiya.
english: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

lokele: Nde bato angɛnɛ ebatotinyomo totombe baitolitesa Bikela, kongo ko balɛmbi ino ndotinyomo mbo baomaleke mbo ino nd’asotinyomo nda bindo yanu.
english: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.

lokele: Nde imi angokulya loomala, ango sinyo, sakolo ngo ko eloa lieka lia Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya; nda lieka lina liande wenda-bo bosowa ende’mi la imi imɔ isowela wenda bototina.
english: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

lokele: Itombe siti to la litina, la losunga loti ango la litina, kangä boyaeli wa liwawi liyai.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

lokele: Lilatemi la shota biyaleke la bato ebatokɛsɛnɛ nda mboka-ye ya fii la biyaleke imɔ la BaIsalaele ba Mungu!
english: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

lokele: Ko la mbile ebikayeke, boto angɔmɔi ataokesa’mi bonui eoka nda lokomba loami imi nd’atoli ngelo ya Yesu.
english: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

lokele: Bitungani yami, booto wa Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya boyalaneke la belimo yanu. Ongoma.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
